Regenerate with: cd tests/browser && npx playwright test --list --reporter=json
scripts/gate.mjs diffs the collected set against this file and fails on any
mismatch, so a spec that silently stops being collected — a bad testMatch, a
file rename, a top-level throw during load — is caught. The matrix runner's
declaration-drift check covers tier A only, and every other baseline is
derived FROM collection, so without this a vanished tier-B spec is invisible.
A value may be a number, or an array when a file's collection legitimately
varies by profile — update the array deliberately, never to silence a run.

variants.oidc.spec.ts: 4 with OIDC/WebAuthn sequencing off, 5 with it on. The spec picks its scenario suite at COLLECTION time from the declared oidc_webauthn_sequencing_enabled (specs/oidc.spec.ts) so that exactly one variant per journey is reported per profile; the sequencing suite carries one extra scenario, oidc-webauthn-assertion, which is the suite's only WebAuthn assertion ceremony (R-5).
